pixelRead.observation: First split left allele A/right allele a; second split B/b; bottom circled A–D are locator labels. Locator A=AB,B=Ab,C=aB,D=ab. Source SVG exposes this key; labeling PNG is a distinct protected answer-free image. Each endpoint has probability1/4.
pixelRead.labelingPngObservation: Exact original labeling PNG also viewed. Its first split is upper allele A/lower allele a, with terminal locator letters A–D top to bottom. Teaching SVG uses left/right branches and terminal letters left to right. Both have A=AB,B=Ab,C=aB,D=ab. Do not transplant upper/lower directions from labeling PNG into SVG teaching instructions.
